messages.not_reviewable: This lab result cannot be confirmed right now

validation.files_required: Add at least one photo or PDF of the lab sheet.
validation.file_type: Only photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or PDF files are accepted.
validation.image_too_large: Each photo can be at most 5 MB.
validation.pdf_too_large: Each PDF can be at most 10 MB.
validation.upload_too_large: The files are too large in total.
validation.image_unreadable: This photo could not be read; choose another one.
validation.future_date: The test date cannot be in the future.

validation.ref_order: The lower bound of the reference range must be below the upper bound.

summary.no_ranges: No reference range was found on the sheet for these values, so they were not compared.
summary.all_normal: All :count markers are within the reference range printed on your lab sheet.
summary.attention: :count values are outside the reference range on your sheet: :list.
summary.doctor: This is general information, not a diagnosis; go over the results with your doctor.

questions.repeat: When should I repeat the test?
questions.routine: How often should I repeat this test?

red_flags.urgent_low: :name is far below the usual range; contact a doctor today.
red_flags.urgent_high: :name is far above the usual range; contact a doctor today.
red_flags.soon_low: :name is markedly low; see a doctor soon.
red_flags.soon_high: :name is markedly high; see a doctor soon.

trend.rising: It has been rising over your last :count tests.
trend.falling: It has been falling over your last :count tests.
trend.stable: It has stayed about the same over your last :count tests.
trend.single: A trend shows once this marker is in at least 2 of your lab results.

context.period_days: Your periods are logged as :days days long.
context.mode_ttc: As you are trying to conceive, go over the result with your doctor soon.
context.mode_pregnancy: Reference ranges differ in pregnancy; go over the result with your doctor.
context.mode_postpartum: Some values change after giving birth; go over the result with your doctor.
context.mode_menopause: Some ranges differ in menopause; go over the result with your doctor.
context.range_varies: This marker depends on the cycle day or age; it is read against the range on the same sheet and the cycle day of the test.

errors.ai_failed: The sheet could not be analysed; please upload it again.
errors.ai_unavailable: The analysis service is not available right now.
errors.ai_budget_exhausted: The analysis service reached today's limit; try again later.
errors.unreadable: The lab file could not be read; please upload it again.
errors.nothing_read: No values could be read; take a clearer photo with every column visible.
errors.consent_required: Your consent to send the data is needed for the analysis.
errors.internal: Something went wrong; please try again.
